interventions: Increase adult female vector mortality rate
description: A compartmental model for Zika Virus (ZIKV) with a vector-host structure. It uses an SEIR model for the human population with logistic growth, and an SEI model for the vector population which includes dynamic growth and the egg, larva, and pupa life stages. The model is intended to understand ZIKV disease dynamics, derive the basic reproduction number, and evaluate the effectiveness of different containment strategies.
